title: Course registration on a small ORM: roster changes that never reach the database
name: Unit-of-work enrollment

questions.prompt: Registrar staff report that course pages show seats as taken while the class list is empty, waitlisted students vanish, and when someone drops a class nobody is promoted off the waitlist. Credit totals on student records look right. Fix the Session in orm/session.ts so the tests pass, keeping flush() writing only the columns that changed.
